title: DevTools, Text Search & JavaScript Bridge
summary: Open Chromium DevTools, find text on pages, execute JavaScript, extract HTML/text content, and resolve favicons.

sections.title: Opening Developer Tools
sections.content: The `browser.devTools` facade provides direct control over the native Chromium Developer Tools window.

sections.title: Find Text on Page
sections.content: The `browser.search` facade provides in-page text search with highlighting, case sensitivity, and directional navigation — similar to Ctrl+F in a browser.

sections.title: JavaScript Execution & Bridge
sections.content: The `browser.jsBridge` facade provides bidirectional JavaScript interoperability with both fire-and-forget execution and async evaluated results.

sections.title: Java CompletableFuture Interop
sections.content: All suspend JS bridge methods have `*Async` counterparts for Java interop.
